# CurseForge project submission

## Project name

Sacks 'N Such: Community Port

## Summary

An unofficial NeoForge 1.21.1 community port of Sacks 'N Such for TerraFirmaCraft.

## Description

Sacks 'N Such: Community Port updates Traister101's MIT-licensed Sacks 'N Such mod for
Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1, Java 21, and the TerraFirmaCraft 4.x ecosystem.

The mod adds configurable handheld storage containers such as sacks, baskets, pouches, and
frame packs. It also includes hiking boots, horseshoes, automatic item pickup options, Curios
integration, and support for container slots that exceed the usual stack-size limit.

This is an independently maintained, unofficial port. Traister101 is the original author;
the original project is available at:
https://github.com/Traister101/Sacks-and-Such

Source and issue tracker for this port:
https://github.com/syntaxHighlight/Sacks-and-Such
https://github.com/syntaxHighlight/Sacks-and-Such/issues

## Project settings

- License: MIT
- Environment: Client and Server
- Categories: Storage; Utility & QoL; Addons
- Required dependency: TerraFirmaCraft
- Optional dependency: Curios API
- Game version: Minecraft 1.21.1
- Mod loader: NeoForge
- Java version: 21
- Project icon: `resources/external/sns_fork_icon.png`

Upload `build/libs/Sacks 'N Such-1.21.1-1.3.0-alpha.0.jar` as an Alpha file. After the
